title: 情報セキュリティ
subtitle: Information Security

NINAGAWA Shigeru
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, you can learn cryptography and network security. The first half of the course deals with elliptic curve cryptography which is gradually spreading in practice. The second half of the course deal with adaptation of security technique such as encryption and authentication to the Internet.
advice:
In the first half of the course, the textbook "誤り訂正符号と暗号の基礎数理" is used and you can learn cryptography especially ellipctic curve cryptography.
In the second half of the course, the textbook "マスタリングTCP/IP　情報セキュリティ編" is used. The students learn adaptation of security technique such as encryption and authentication to the Internet environment. The students also learn general network security. Understanding TCP/IP is important.
books:
笠原正雄，佐竹賢治著：誤り訂正符号と暗号の基礎数理，コロナ社，2004
齋藤孝道著：マスタリングTCP/IP 情報セキュリティ編，オーム社，2013
requiredKnowledge:
Taking "Algebra for Computer Science" helps to learn this course especially for the first half of the course.
Knowledge about TCP/IP is required.

              In this course, you can learn cryptography and network security. The first half of the course deals with elliptic curve cryptography which is gradually spreading in practice. The second half of the course deal with adaptation of security technique such as encryption and authentication to the Internet.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In the first half of the course, the textbook "誤り訂正符号と暗号の基礎数理" is used and you can learn cryptography especially ellipctic curve cryptography.
In the second half of the course, the textbook "マスタリングTCP/IP　情報セキュリティ編" is used. The students learn adaptation of security technique such as encryption and authentication to the Internet environment. The students also learn general network security. Understanding TCP/IP is important.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              笠原正雄，佐竹賢治著：誤り訂正符号と暗号の基礎数理，コロナ社，2004
齋藤孝道著：マスタリングTCP/IP 情報セキュリティ編，オーム社，2013

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Taking "Algebra for Computer Science" helps to learn this course especially for the first half of the course.
Knowledge about TCP/IP is required.
